wiki.title: Daniel Didech
wiki.extract: Daniel Calmon Didech (born 1986/1987) is an American attorney and politician serving as a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 59th district since 2019. The district, located in the Chicago metropolitan area, includes all or part of Vernon Hills, Prairie View, Buffalo Grove, Indian Creek, Lincolnshire, Mundelein, Riverwoods, and Wheeling.
